name: barrel
title: The barrel cartridge: the slot the sled and the disc run in, with the magazine column over its mouth
orientation: Flat on the bed on its floor, open side up. The sled drops into the slot from the open side, the cartridge goes into the frame's cavity open side first over the action cartridge, and is pinned through its walls from the frame's edges. The disc rolls along the frame's cavity wall. Discs and the magazine insert go in through the column's top.

slot.rule: The slot's height: the disc and a fit each side

rail.rule: The slot's floor and ceiling walls: the floor wall is the cartridge's bottom edge

case_h.rule: The cartridge's depth off the bed: the disc and a fit each side, to the frame's cavity wall it rolls along

back.rule: The back wall's outer face: flush with the action cartridge's

muzzle.rule: The barrel's end: past the column, so the disc is guided until the sled stops

band.rule: The top edge of the tube outside the column: a top wall over a hollow above the ceiling, for the pins' barbs

top.rule: The column walls' top: half the insert's cap stands above it, to be gripped

tooth_back.rule: The sear tooth's holding face, from the action cartridge

sear_w.rule: The tooth's width: its slit through the floor wall

col0.rule: The column's rear wall, inner face: the mouth starts a fit ahead of the tooth, the ledge behind that

col1.rule: The column's front wall, inner face: the follower and a fit each side

cap_bottom.value: sled.thickness / 2 + launcher.capacity * launcher.disc_t + magazine.follower + magazine.thickness + (magazine.turns - 1) * magazine.pitch - magazine.preload - magazine.stroke - magazine.overlap
cap_bottom.rule: The insert's cap, its underside, pressed home over a full stack resting on the sled

notch_y.rule: The bottom of the notches the cap's barbs snap into

notch_h.rule: The notches' height: the barbs' lead, flat and back, with room

overlap.rule: How far parts sink into each other, so they join

pin_z.rule: The pins' height off the bed: the middle of the walls

pin_y.rule: The pins' y: the middle of the hollow over the ceiling. One forward through the back wall, one back through the muzzle's front wall, from the frame's edges

tooth_room.rule: Room either side of the sear's tooth in its slit: the tooth tips a little as the trigger drops it; the slit stays a bridge the printer spans
